hints.title: Suffix Trimming
hints.text: For each query (k, trim), slice the last trim characters of each string.

hints.title: Stable Tie Breaking
hints.text: When trimmed substrings are identical, order them by their original 0-indexed position.

hints.title: Query Evaluation
hints.text: Construct pairs of (trimmed_str, original_index), sort or select the kth smallest pair, and record original_index.

hints.title: Trim and Sort Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full integer conversion can exceed standard 64-bit integer limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String slices are created per query.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles string lexicographical comparisons and original index stability.
